aitmpl.description: Official MCP server of the aitmpl.com catalog: lets Claude search Claude Code components (agents, commands, skills, hooks, MCP servers, settings, loops, mods and plugins), read one with its full content and SkillSpector scan, and get the claude-code-templates command that installs it. It also serves two skills over MCP (Claude Code 2.1.331 or later): component-review and skill-over-mcp. Remote, read-only, no sign-in; it installs nothing itself, Claude runs the returned command.

aitmpl.name: search_components
aitmpl.title: Search aitmpl components
aitmpl.description: Search the catalog by text and get each match's id, description, page, install command and SkillSpector scan, ordered by how well the text matches.

aitmpl.name: get_component
aitmpl.title: Get an aitmpl component
aitmpl.description: Return one component by id with its full content, the files it ships, what it writes on install, its license and source, and its SkillSpector scan.

aitmpl.name: get_install_command
aitmpl.title: Get the install command
aitmpl.description: Return the single claude-code-templates command that installs up to 20 components into the current project.

aitmpl.name: list_categories
aitmpl.title: List aitmpl categories
aitmpl.description: List the component types with their counts, and the categories of one type or all types.

aitmpl.name: component-review
aitmpl.description: Review a Claude Code component (agent, command, skill, hook, MCP server config or setting) before sharing it or sending it to aitmpl.com.

aitmpl.name: skill-over-mcp
aitmpl.description: Build an MCP server that serves skills (Skills over MCP, extension io.modelcontextprotocol/skills) with the official TypeScript SDK.
